holotrade_carrier_note: Holotrade's K81 = Reg(H27) (x) Reg(C3) with an EXTERNAL C3.  Both H27 x C3 groups are SmallGroup(81,12) or (81,13), never the unique order-81 subgroup class (81,7) of PSp(4,3); so the full K81 action is not a Steinberg restriction, while its H27 part is (St_81 restricted to each order-27 subgroup is 3 copies of the regular module).

theorem: The 40-line module 1+15+24 of PSp(4,3) admits no equivariant map into St_81 for the full group (Schur) but admits nonzero equivariant maps for 115 of 116 subgroup classes; an INJECTIVE (equivalently isometric) equivariant map exists only for 36 subgroup classes of order <= 24.  It fails for every maximal subgroup, the Sylow-3 subgroup SmallGroup(81,7) and all three order-27 subgroups, where the H-orbit count on the 40 lines (4, 6, 8 for order 27; 4 for order 81) exceeds the number of invariant directions in St_81 (3; 1).  This is a character-theoretic no-go for a lossless symmetry-preserving embedding of the line signal into Holotrade's K81 slice.
